scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Umbala^000000,
the Village of the Utan Tribe.
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
歡迎來到烏坦族的村莊^8B4513汶巴拉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
Since I have been exploring here for several months.
I am familiar with this area's geography and the points of interest in this village.
Do you need help navigating the village?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
我在這裡探索了好幾個月，對附近的地形和村裡的景點都很熟悉。
需要我為您指路嗎？

scripts.text: [ Kafra Employee ]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉職員]

scripts.text: [ Chief's House ]
scripts.translation: [首領之家]

scripts.text: [ Shaman's House ]
scripts.translation: [薩滿的住所]

scripts.translation: [武器店]

scripts.text: [ Tool Shop ]
scripts.translation: [道具店]

scripts.translation: [高空彈跳區]

scripts.text: [ Tree of Yggdrasil ]
scripts.translation: [世界樹]

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地圖示記

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
Let me mark the location of the
^0000FFKafra Employee^000000
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
我會在您的小地圖上標記^0000FF卡普拉職員^000000的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
Only the {0} knows the language of the outside world.
So you'd better visit him before anything else.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
只有{0}懂外界的語言，最好先去拜訪他。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
The {0} has some sort of mystic power.
People say she can create rough enchanted stones, and divide a pure enchanted stone into rough ones.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
{0}有種神秘的力量。
聽說她能製作附魔石原石，還能把完整的附魔石分解成原石。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
The {0} inside Umbala
supplies the weapons
for defending against their enemies.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
汶巴拉的{0}提供用來抵禦敵人的武器。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
There are many useful things for
traveling in the {0} in Umbala.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
汶巴拉的{0}裡有許多旅行用得上的東西。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
Umbala has a unique locale called
the {0}.
If you're interested in testing
your courage, why don't you try it.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
汶巴拉有個獨特的地方叫{0}。
如果您想試試自己的膽量，不妨去挑戰一下。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
There's the {0} in the northern part of town.
You should pay it a visit since that's a place I recommend when you visit Umbala.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
{0}就在城鎮北部。
來汶巴拉的話，我很推薦您去看看。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
Sure, I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
好的，我會清除您小地圖上的所有標記。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Umbala Guide]
Be safe on your travels.
scripts.translation:
[汶巴拉向導]
祝您旅途平安。
